{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cartann Ground Championship''' was a [[blastsword]] duel tournament held annually on the nation of [[Cartann]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. It served no purpose aside from entertainment, continuing of a tradition loved by the people of Cartann and establishing the new [[Cartann Ground Champion]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], the reigning champion was [[Cheriss ke Hanadi]].
